metadata.question: Does Kerala, India experience more rainfall between July and August 2018 compared to Sri Lanka?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data (high resolution for rainfall) - Date: July-August 2018 (2018-07-01 to 2018-08-31) - Location: Kerala, India and Sri Lanka (need to define geometries for both regions) 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS precipitation data doesn't need cloud masking (it's already processed) - Question is directly about rainfall, so no masking needed 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total rainfall could legitimately be 0 mm (dry period) - C1: If collection is empty for either location - C2: If no valid pixels after processing - C3: If result is None/NaN or invalid (negative rainfall) - A: If Kerala rainfall > Sri Lanka rainfall - B: If Kerala rainfall <= Sri Lanka rainfall ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const kerala = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[74.8, 8.2], [77.5, 8.2], [77.5, 12.8], [74.8, 12.8], [74.8, 8.2]] ]); const sriLanka = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[79.5, 5.9], [82.0, 5.9], [82.0, 9.9], [79.5, 9.9], [79.5, 5.9]] ]); const startDate = '2018-07-01'; const endDate = '2018-08-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images Found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No CHIRPS data available for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum total rainfall const totalRainfall = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate rainfall for both regions const keralaStats = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kerala, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const sriLankaStats = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sriLanka, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const keralaRainfall = keralaStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const sriLankaRainfall = sriLankaStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const keralaCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kerala, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const sriLankaCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sriLanka, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Kerala: ${keralaRainfall !== null ? keralaRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm (Pixels: ${keralaCount})`); console.log(`Sri Lanka: ${sriLankaRainfall !== null ? sriLankaRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm (Pixels: ${sriLankaCount})`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (keralaCount === 0 || sriLankaCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels found."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (keralaRainfall === null || sriLankaRainfall === null || isNaN(keralaRainfall) || isNaN(sriLankaRainfall) || keralaRainfall < 0 || sriLankaRainfall < 0) { console.log("Invalid calculation result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (keralaRainfall > sriLankaRainfall) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
